mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level directly increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, reducing present value of future earnings and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level as predictor of 20-day returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in the prior month, or Rank IC for the trigger condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (exceeding 0.1 percentage points) and decline in industrial production (falling below 110.0 index) indicates dual deterioration in labor market and manufacturing output, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (UNRATE rise >0.1pp and INDPRO fall <110.0) occurs in more than 40% of cases where 20-day returns are positive, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1950 units signals sustained consumer demand for residential construction, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal condition (UNRATE <5.0% and HOUST>1950) occurs in more than 40% of cases where 20-day returns are negative, or Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 110.0 index signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO < 110.0 as predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03, or 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the condition.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated housing starts (HOUST) above 1900 units reflects strong consumer demand for residential construction, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST level as predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03, or correlation between HOUST level and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 200.0 index signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 200.0 as predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03, or 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (exceeding 1000 persons) and drop in industrial production (below 110.0 index) indicates broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS fall >1000 and INDPRO fall <110) occurs in more than 40% of cases where 20-day returns are positive, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
